look_here_first: Start with the leaves: smooth to glabrous sessile leaves with rounded bases visibly clasp the stem. Yellow rays often show a reddish-brown basal eye around the raised dark cone.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: annual or short-lived perennial; mostly glabrous shoots; sessile leaves with rounded clasping bases; single terminal yellow heads; yellow rays often with dark basal eye; raised conic to barrel-shaped disk; outer phyllaries spreading to reflexed

key_traits.label: Comparison training
key_traits.text: The clasping leaf bases are the fastest separator; do not use yellow ray color alone.

lookalikes.differences: R. amplexicaulis is smoother and has conspicuously clasping sessile leaves; R. hirta is generally hairier and lacks the same clasping leaf-base look.
